name: 48617 · Clare, MI
findings: ZIP 48617 (Clare) has 41 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48617 (Clare) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48617 (Clare) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 51% of all organizations here have no identified type.
